name: drupal/adminlte
description: Official AdminLTE 4 admin theme for Drupal — Bootstrap 5.3, vanilla JS, light & dark modes.

suggest.drupal/ui_patterns: Surfaces the theme's SDC components (small box, info box, callout) in Layout Builder, Views and field formatters.
suggest.drupal/ui_icons: Adds the bundled Bootstrap Icons pack to Drupal's Icon API pickers (enable the ui_icons_font submodule).
